figure.purpose: The one hero number per screen, on its construction grid (cell = size/10). Max 88px on Home, 72px on Goals and Dollar Tracker; sized down to fit the final value.

large-title.purpose: Collapsing iOS large title on each top-level tab.

headline-row.purpose: Section headers, row amounts, stat-strip values.

label.purpose: Stat labels and split percentages, sentence case, Ink Secondary.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system has no shadows; depth is value layering plus platform bar blur.

materials.purpose: Tab bar and collapsed title bar.

motion.name: figure-count-up
motion.purpose: Dot-grid figure counts to its value; grid size fixed from the final value.

motion.name: fill-once
motion.purpose: Split bar and flat progress bars fill once, ease-out-expo; zero duration under Reduce Motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square full-width Signal Orange action; one per screen or sheet.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; height: 52px; background: #FF5A1F; color: #140A05; border: none; border-radius: 0; font: 600 15px system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FF8452; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid #F2F2F0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #26272C; color: #7C8088; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary full-width action with a 1.5px outline.

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Square module; selected inverts to ink. No legend colour.

components.description: Filled square field; ink 1.5px outline on focus.

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Floating frosted-glass bar inset from the edges, icon-only tabs (names go to VoiceOver), square orange add block.
components.html: HomeHistoryMonthlyGoals
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 49px; padding-top: 6px; background: rgba(16,17,19,0.94); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border-top: 0.5px solid #2A2C31; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; text-align: center; color: #7C8088; font: 500 10px system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #A2A6AD; } .ds-tab-on { color: #F2F2F0; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab-add { flex: none; margin: 0 22px; width: 52px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #FF5A1F; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-add:hover { background: #FF8452; } .ds-tab-add:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid #F2F2F0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dot Figure
components.description: The one hero number: dot-grid numerals on a construction grid whose cell is a tenth of the figure size.
components.css: .ds-figure { --cell: 8.8px; padding: var(--cell) 0; background-color: #101113; background-image: linear-gradient(#1C1E22 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, #1C1E22 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: var(--cell) var(--cell); } .ds-figure-label { height: calc(var(--cell) * 3); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; margin-bottom: var(--cell); color: #A2A6AD; font: 600 15px system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-figure-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-figure-sign { width: calc(var(--cell) * 4); padding-top: var(--cell); color: #FF5A1F; font: 600 calc(var(--cell) * 3.4)/1 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-figure-num { color: #FF5A1F; font-family: 'Doto', monospace; font-size: 88px; line-height: 0.9; font-variation-settings: 'wght' 900; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0; }

components.css: .ds-coupon { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 60px; background: #26272C; border-radius: 0; color: #F2F2F0; font: 400 17px system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle 6px at 64px 0, transparent 6px, #000 6.5px) top / 100% 51% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle 6px at 64px 100%, transparent 6px, #000 6.5px) bottom / 100% 51% no-repeat; } .ds-coupon:hover { background: #2C2D33; } .ds-coupon:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid #F2F2F0; } .ds-coupon-stub { width: 64px; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; text-align: center; color: #A2A6AD; font-size: 15px; border-right: 1.5px dashed #3A3C42; } .ds-coupon-body { flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 12px 14px; } .ds-coupon-body small { display: block; color: #A2A6AD; font-size: 15px; } .ds-coupon-body b { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-neg { color: #FF3D6E; } .ds-coupon-upcoming { background: transparent; outline: 1.5px dashed #7C8088; outline-offset: -1.5px; -webkit-mask: none; } .ds-coupon-upcoming:hover { background: transparent; } .ds-coupon-upcoming .ds-coupon-stub { color: #7C8088; border-right-color: #7C8088; } .ds-coupon-review { overflow: visible; -webkit-mask: none; } .ds-stamp { position: absolute; right: 10px; top: -7px; transform: rotate(-4deg); background: #101113; border: 1.5px solid #FF3D6E; border-radius: 3px; padding: 1px 6px; color: #FF3D6E; font: normal 800 11px system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.8px; }

components.css: .ds-stats { display: flex; background: #101113; padding: 12px 0; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stats > div { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 0 12px; } .ds-stats > div + div { border-left: 0.5px solid #2A2C31; } .ds-stats > div:first-child { padding-left: 0; } .ds-stats span { color: #A2A6AD; font: 500 13px inherit; } .ds-stats b { color: #F2F2F0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 17px; }

narrative.overview:
A Crouwel-style gridded type specimen, fused with a jet-age ticket wallet. Each screen may carry one monumental figure, built from Doto dot-grid numerals on a faint square construction grid whose cell is exactly one tenth of the figure size, so every dot lands in a cell. Everything else is small, exact and tabular: the platform sans (SF Pro on iOS, Roboto on Android) in iOS text-style sizes, with tabular figures throughout. Home's figure is Available; Goals and a goal's detail use a bone Savings figure; the Dollar Tracker uses a blue USD figure. The add sheet sets its amount entry as a dot-grid figure.

Colour works as a legend, not as decoration. Each saturated hue has one meaning and appears only where that meaning applies. Surfaces are square, flat modules one value step above a near-black ground; edges come from layering and hairlines, never from glow, gradient or shadow. Entries are coupons: a date stub, a perforation with two half-round notches, then the body. Their state is drawn as form: posted entries are solid, upcoming ones are dashed outlines, and SMS entries awaiting review carry a red rubber stamp.

Navigation is native iOS: large titles that collapse to inline titles on scroll, a floating frosted-glass icon-only tab bar, and the add action as a square orange block. Dark appearance only.
keyCharacteristics: At most one dot-grid figure per screen, always on its construction grid.
A strict colour legend: orange Available, bone Savings, green income, magenta-red spending, yellow warnings, blue USD.
Square corners on every module; the only softness comes from coupon notches, the stamp and the platform sheet.
Hairlines (0.5px) and flat value layering replace borders, glows and shadows.
Entries are coupons whose state shows in their form.
Platform sans with tabular figures, sentence case, no tracking.

rules.name: The Legend Rule
rules.body: Every saturated hue has one meaning. If a colour would appear somewhere its meaning does not apply, use Ink or a neutral instead.

rules.name: The Orange Is Available Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange marks the Available balance and the single primary action on a screen. Nothing else: not selected filters, not icons, not decoration.

rules.name: The Controls Are Ink Rule
rules.body: Selection states for filters, segmented controls and active tabs invert to Ink on Ground or brighten to Ink. Controls are not data, so they carry no legend colour. A selected category tile takes its own ramp colour as an outline.

rules.name: The One Figure Rule
rules.body: Doto appears at most once per screen, always over its construction grid (cell = size / 10), with no letter spacing and the 0.9 even leading, so each dot sits in a whole cell. Don't use it for row amounts or labels.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and section titles use sentence case with no tracking ("Available", "This month"). The only uppercase, tracked text in the system is the UNCHECKED review stamp, which is a stamped object rather than a label.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows, gradients or orbs. If something needs to stand apart, raise its value one step or rule it with a hairline.

dos: Do give a screen at most one Doto figure, on its construction grid with cell = size / 10.
Do colour by the legend: orange for Available and the primary action, bone for Savings, green for income, magenta-red for spending and stamps, yellow for warnings, blue for USD.
Do draw entries as coupons and show their state as form: solid, dashed, or stamped.
Do keep every module square and separate modules with value steps and 0.5px Hairlines.
Do use the platform sans with tabular figures, in sentence case.
Do use native iOS structure: collapsing large titles, a floating frosted icon-only tab bar, 44pt targets, and VoiceOver labels on figures and bars.
Do honour Reduce Motion by setting fills and count-ups to zero duration.
donts: Don't use Signal Orange for selection states, icons, filters or decoration.
Don't use USD Blue for anything taka, or the legend hues for categories.
Don't add shadows, glows, gradients, glass orbs or rounded cards.
Don't set row amounts, labels or titles in Doto, or track or letter-space Doto.
Don't add uppercase tracked eyebrow labels above titles or figures.
Don't add 1px borders around posted modules; outlines belong only to state (upcoming, focus, stamp, selected tile).
